name: Gouonji Shizuka
source: The eldest of the three daughters. A calm and easygoing woman. Her father has arranged her to be married to an old friend of the protagonist's, but she doesn't seem happy about it.
translation: The eldest of the three daughters. A calm and easygoing woman. Her father has arranged her to be married to an old friend of the protagonist's, but she doesn't seem happy about it.
